nodes.name: TodayStatusBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: TodayStatusBadge component: displays current attendance status (checked in, checked out, on leave, remote) with colored indicator dot, timestamp, and location. Real-time updates via SWR polling. Used in dashboard header and attendance overview.

nodes.name: AttendanceOverviewTab.tsx
nodes.summary: AttendanceOverviewTab component: tabbed interface for attendance dashboard (overview, leave, overtime, schedule). Manages active tab state, lazy loads tab panels, and handles data fetching coordination. Parent of TodayStatusBadge, LeaveOvertimeHubTab, MyOverviewTab, WorkShiftTab.

nodes.name: LeaveOvertimeHubTab.tsx
nodes.summary: LeaveOvertimeHubTab component: combined leave and overtime summary with balance cards, recent requests list, quick action buttons, and status filters. Shared between employee and manager views with role-based content.

nodes.name: MyOverviewTab.tsx
nodes.summary: MyOverviewTab component: personal attendance metrics (working hours, late count, leave used, OT hours) with period selector, trend mini-charts, and comparison to team average. Employee self-view only.

nodes.name: WorkShiftTab.tsx
nodes.summary: WorkShiftTab component: shift calendar with drag-drop assignment, shift template selector, conflict detection badge, swap request button, and weekly/monthly view toggle. Manager editable, employee read-only.

nodes.name: ChatMessage.tsx
nodes.summary: ChatMessage component: renders user/assistant messages with markdown, code syntax highlighting, citation chips with DocumentPreviewModal trigger, streaming text animation, copy button, and feedback actions (thumbs up/down).

nodes.name: DocumentPreviewModal.tsx
nodes.summary: DocumentPreviewModal component: modal dialog for previewing cited documents (PDF iframe, image gallery, text snippet). Highlights matched text, shows relevance score, and provides download/open-in-new-tab actions. Lazy loaded.

nodes.name: Button.tsx
nodes.summary: Button component: variant (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive), size (sm, md, lg), loading state with spinner, disabled state, icon support (left/right), and asChild for polymorphic rendering. Built on Radix Slot.

nodes.name: Table.tsx
nodes.summary: Table component: sortable columns, pagination, row selection, expandable rows, column resizing, sticky header, empty state, and virtualized rows for large datasets. Composable sub-components (Header, Body, Row, Cell, Pagination).

nodes.name: Modal.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal component: Radix Dialog wrapper with sizes (sm, md, lg, xl, full), close on overlay/escape, focus trap, portal rendering, scroll lock, and animation variants (fade, slide). Used for all forms and confirmations.
